why: The upstream documents and their transcribed cell grids are not in this
repository and must not be. They are under the NVIDIA Asset License
Agreement: evaluation is permitted, redistribution is not, and a verbatim
transcription of an NVIDIA document's own table cells committed to a public
repository is a partial reproduction of the asset. Decided on SUP-874,
This manifest is what makes the comparison reproducible without publishing
either. Point INGEST_BAKEOFF_REAL_DIR at a directory holding the ground-truth
files below; the harness verifies both sides against these hashes, so a
re-run proves it scored the same extraction against the same truth. With the
directory absent the harness skips these rows and says so.

documents.licence: NVIDIA Asset License Agreement (data/LICENSE.DATA in that tree)

files.contains: one 21x6 table, 6 columns including the header row

files.name: multimodal_test.pdf
files.contains: two tables, two charts, three bullet points - the document states this expectation in its own conclusion
